method: Independent manual visual extraction from open-circle neutral I2 symbols only; no coordinates taken from smooth lines or indexed descriptions.
priorExposure: Digitizer previously read the V79 report and its summary velocity comparison during source research; did not inspect velocity prediction packets during brightness extraction. This is not wholly blinded digitization.
coordinateConvention: Pixel origin top left; x rightward, y downward.
uncertaintyInterpretation: Conservative manual center and axis extraction ranges in the supplied crop, not standard deviations or bounds on unreported experimental calibration/noise. Published experimental error bars are not visible.

sourceCaveats: Brightness is chord integrated; the source explicitly says Abel inversion was not applied.
Figure 6 identifies the neutral brightness line as 4702 angstrom; the neutral velocity diagnostic line is not explicitly identified.
The monochromator intensity is not explicitly defined as integrated line area rather than an instrument-channel/peak signal.
Absolute radiometric calibration, flat-field response, optical depth and experimental uncertainty are unreported.
